failures.recovery: materialize the row array before piping

failures.failed_witness: a broad external receipt discovery projection exceeded its output budget
failures.recovery: use the exact receipt path surfaced before truncation

failures.failed_witness: a redundant activation-candidate reference projection truncated
failures.recovery: use the completed bounded full-file read and exact paths

failures.failed_witness: an archive verifier bundled recursive temporary cleanup and was rejected before process start
failures.recovery: use a byte-preserving read-only Git-blob stream without extraction or deletion

failures.failed_witness: the first blob verifier guessed one digest key across seven manifest schemas and emitted false mismatches
failures.recovery: inspect each manifest schema and replay with its actual digest and byte fields

failures.failed_witness: the first combined collision probe returned no attributable scalar after its remote lookup window
failures.recovery: separate literal local, registry, path, and live-remote probes

failures.failed_witness: the first combined x1 patch exceeded the Windows process command-line ceiling and was rejected
failures.recovery: apply the same owner patch through a bounded junction-backed patch surface

failures.failed_witness: a precommit unit-test wrapper launched from the parent C-drive directory and could not import the sparse D-drive test module
failures.recovery: run the unchanged test selection with the exact owner worktree as process working directory

promotion_rule: A recovery may earn a separate bounded witness but never rewrites its failed witness.
